takeaways.text: Johnny Walker defeated Waldo Cortes Acosta by TKO (strikes).
Petersen recovered from early trouble to stop Lorenco late in round three.
Raposo beat UFC newcomer Degli on all three scorecards, ending his 13-fight winning streak.
Nolan stopped Moicano in the third round for a major win over an established contender.
Smith took the Brown fight on short notice and won every scorecard 30–26, remaining unbeaten.
Doctor stoppages ended the Lebosnoyani–Hasanov and Sezinando–Berggren bouts.
Clarke upset former world champion Billam-Smith with a seventh-round stoppage.
Bentley edged Mosley Jr. on all three scorecards in a competitive ten-round fight.
Massenaux protested the fifth-round stoppage against Hickey; the official recap also questioned its timing.
Hutchinson avenged his earlier defeat to Buatsi, winning the rematch unanimously.
Rafferty beat Martirosyan on points, with a final-round knockdown helping secure the victory.
Rea delivered an early statement on the undercard, stopping Taylor in round two.

divisionMethodology: Bout divisions were cross-checked against UFC and Zuffa official weigh-in reports and published Buatsi–Hutchinson fight-card listings. When weigh-in figures exceed the advertised limit, the division is identified as the listed category and the discrepancy is noted; the actual contracted limit is not assumed.
